questions.question: Should print_report in cli.py get the same separators too?

options.label: Yes, also cli.py
options.adds: Also change print_report in cli.py from :.2f to :,.2f.

rewriteBeforeAnswers: In `budget.py`, change the alert lines so `spent` and `limit` use thousands separators (`:.2f` becomes `:,.2f`, so 1500.00 shows as 1,500.00 for finance). Change only that formatting, don't add tests, then run `python3 run_tests.py` and confirm it still passes.
final: In `budget.py`, change the alert lines so `spent` and `limit` use thousands separators (`:.2f` becomes `:,.2f`, so 1500.00 shows as 1,500.00 for finance). Change only that formatting, don't add tests, then run `python3 run_tests.py` and confirm it still passes. Leave print_report in cli.py unchanged.
